preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 1000 and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 5000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Input must contain exactly m lines after the first line, where n and m satisfy 2 ≤ n ≤ 1000 and 1 ≤ m ≤ 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) < int(b) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each flight is a one-directional edge from city a to city b where 1 ≤ a < b ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: len(set((int(a), int(b)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()])) == m
preconditions.description: No two flights are between the same pair of cities (no duplicate edges).

preconditions.expression: all(not any((int(a), int(b)) == (int(x), int(y)) and (int(x), int(y)) != (int(a), int(b)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()] for x, y in [line.split()]))
preconditions.description: No cyclical paths exist in the directed graph (no directed cycles).

preconditions.expression: any(all(int(b) == n for a, b in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if int(a) == 1)) or any(all(int(a) == 1 for a, b in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if int(b) == n))
preconditions.description: There exists at least one path from city 1 to city n using the given flights (strongly connected from 1 to n).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'No' or (stdout.strip() == 'Yes' and len(stdout.splitlines()) == m + 1 and all(line in ['1', '2'] for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If no valid assignment exists, output is exactly 'No'. Otherwise, output is 'Yes' followed by m lines, each containing either 1 or 2, representing flight durations.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Yes' and all(1 <= int(duration) <= 2 for duration in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each flight duration in the output is either 1 or 2.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Yes' and (lambda: all(all(sum(int(duration) for a, b, duration in zip(edges, durations)) == T for path in paths) for T in [sum(int(duration) for a, b, duration in zip(edges, durations)) for path in paths if all(int(b) == n for a, b in path)]) if (lambda: (edges := [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]]), (durations := [line for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]]), (paths := [path for path in dfs_paths(1, n, edges)]) and paths) else False)()
postconditions.description: For all paths from city 1 to city n, the sum of flight durations along the path is the same (all paths have equal total duration). Here, `dfs_paths` is a helper to generate all paths from 1 to n using the given edges.
